title: Zentry
award: Awwwards Site of the Day, Aug 28 2024 (Honors); corpus bucket category-mix (also sites_of_the_month). Agency: Resn. NOTE: the live site probed 2026-09 is a relaunch ('Human-Agentic OS', ZENT token) built on the same Nuxt component system; the awarded 2024 'metagame' version is reconstructed from the jury element videos.
industry: Web3 gaming / 'metagame layer' platform (2024), repositioned in 2026 as a crypto + AI 'Human-Agentic OS' with the ZENT token
signature: Every image lives inside a JS-computed, perspective-projected rounded quad (four corners rotated in 3D, projected with fl/(fl+z), written every frame to clip-path: path() plus a matching SVG stroke), so flat video and art tilt, float and unfold to full-bleed like physical cards, while an ultra-condensed display face with wedge-cut alternates swings in on a 3D hinge, and even the pill buttons tilt as projected quads.

first_screen.composition: OBSERVED live (desktop_01): pure #000 viewport. 'REDEFINE' top-left in ZentryScreamer 180px (x~36, y~108-245) with a 4-line Roboto Mono paragraph under it at 16.2px / weight 500 (class textBody1 = 1.8rem; 45 mono chars span 437px = 0.6em advance at 16.2px, line pitch ~19.4px = 1.2); 'REALITY' bottom-right at the same 180px, flush to the right margin (~1405px), baseline ~855. On the diagonal between the two words sits an iridescent violet/cyan/magenta wireframe flower (Spline scene A1_update_p8uuko.spline, loaded by the Hero chunk) spanning roughly x 340-965, y 130-745; it only grazes the last E of REDEFINE and stays clear of REALITY. Nav: ZENTRY wordmark top-left, two lavender #DFDFF2 pills (PRODUCTS with caret, WHITEPAPER; 9px bold mono caps), right-hand links ZTERMINAL / ABOUT / CONTACT with a small arrow glyph, 10.8px bold mono caps. desktop_00 (6s) is still the preloader: a #5542FF two-shard Z mark (~207px wide) centred on black. AWARDED 2024 version (frames/zentry/2 f00-f01, frames/zentry/3 f06): the same diagonal REDEFINE / <word> split over a full-bleed looping video of painted game key art; the bottom-right word swaps (GAMING, IDENTITY, LIFESTYLE...) and is caught mid-hinge in f00 ('NTITY' leaning in perspective); a small preview square of the next clip sits at screen centre (it stays centred in f01 while the cursor is far bottom-right, so it does not follow the pointer's position); a lime #EDFF66 'WATCH TRAILER' pill sits under a geometric-sans subtitle. The 2024 nav was the Z mark (no wordmark), a PRODUCTS pill, and NEXUS / VAULT dropdowns + PROLOGUE / ABOUT / CONTACT with a 4-bar audio glyph at the far right.

typography.scale_notes: Everything is in rem on a viewport-width root: html { font-size: .625vw } at >=769px (1rem = 9px at 1440, capped at 12px from 2000px) and 2.6667vw below (1rem = 10.4px at 390), so the whole type scale scales with width. Classes: textTitleBig1 20rem (180px) / 10rem mobile (104px); textTitleSection 12rem (108px, statements and product-menu names) / 4.8rem; textTitleSection2 10rem (90px) lh .85; textBody1 1.8rem (16.2px, weight 500; hero and section copy) / 1.4rem mobile (14.56px); textCaptionBtn 1.2rem (10.8px bold, +0.02em); textCaption 1rem (9px). Measured sizes: 180 / 162 ('$20M') / 144 and 137 / 126 (24B+) / 108 (25 nodes) / 90 / 55 / 20 / 16.2 / 14.4 (body default) / 10.8 / 9 (43 nodes). Display to body 180:16.2 = 11:1; display to micro-label 20:1.
typography.tracking_leading: Display letter-spacing -0.01em (-1.8px at 180px, Hero CSS letter-spacing:-.01em), line-height 0.82 (147.6/180). Stats even tighter: 162px on 116.64px (0.72). Section statements 108px on 88.56px (0.82), -1.08px. Micro labels 9px mono with +0.02em (0.18px) and line-height 1.0.
typography.case_and_style: All display text uppercase. The wedge-cut alternates are switched on per glyph by wrapping a letter in <b> styled font-feature-settings:'ss01' on (Hero CSS .hero__bTitle b; InkTrapText component), so only one or two letters per word carry the notch. Stats use the display face numerals with a '+' suffix (24B+, 970GB+, 100M+, 500K+).
signature_moves: Diagonal split headline: word 1 top-left, word 2 bottom-right, the hero object on the diagonal between them (desktop_01, mobile_00).
Per-glyph stylistic-set accents: <b> inside the heading switches ss01 on one letter per word (A, M, U, W or C gets a wedge cut), so the logo's shard language spreads into every headline.
Headlines hinge in 3D rather than fade: the whole block rotates from rotateY(-50deg) rotateX(-20deg), pivoting 150px behind the text, to flat, while words snap on (Title component).

Stat numerals corner-pinned into perspective: a 4-point homography (usePerspectiveTransform -> matrix3d) pulls the numeral block's bottom-left corner down to 1.3-1.5x its height and the bottom-right up to 0.5-0.6x, so '500K+' and '970GB+' lean at rest (desktop_07) and straighten when hovered.
Inline media chips inside a centred stacked statement: 'A NEW [square] REALITY', 'USER [diamond] AND' (desktop_06; the WhoWeAre dot grows into an image card on hover).
typography.mobile: mobile_00: REDEFINE ~300 css px wide at 104px (textTitleBig1 10rem at 1rem = 10.4px; probe mobile largest 104px; the 81.12px h1 in the probe is another heading), left-aligned; the Roboto Mono paragraph (14.56px = 1.4rem) runs over the wireframe flower, which now fills the full width; REALITY right-aligned at the bottom. No horizontal overflow (probe overflow_x false).

color.section_shifts: Hard cuts, carried by imagery rather than gradients. 2026: black hero -> the dark image quad expands over a lavender field (desktop_02) -> lavender product grid and statements (desktop_03-06) -> black stats bento (desktop_07). 2024: the unfolded painting handed straight into a BLACK product section (frames/zentry/2 f03-f04), then a full-bleed lime #EDFF66 'THE UNIVERSE POWERED BY ZENT' vault section (f05-f06), a black stats bento (f07), and dark teal cinematic Prologue pages (frames/zentry/0).

Content sections sit on a 9rem (~81px) gutter: the first native-product card (zDATA) is full-width, 81-1359 with ~14.4px radius (desktop_03); the integrated-app cards below pair up at 622px with a ~34px gutter (desktop_04: 81-703 and 737-1359). composition_moves: Diagonal corner-to-corner type around a central object.
Every image is a tilted rounded quad with a hairline stroke; neighbouring quads sit at different angles.
Stats bento with deliberately mismatched card sizes and fills: purple-gradient 24B+, white 970GB+, #5542FF 100M+, tall black 500K+, black backers list (desktop_07).

A character layered in front of the '500K+' numerals inside its violet card (frames/zentry/2 f07; a contained video, object-fit contain, 40rem tall per Bento CSS). It covers the type but stays within the card edge.
Numbered 01/02/03 accordion pinned bottom-left with a vertical progress rule (desktop_05).
Product titles set as a tiny lowercase 'z' prefix against the ultra-condensed caps word ('zDATA', desktop_03).
layout.section_rhythm: 100lvh hero -> pinned scroll section in which the tilted frame unfolds to full-bleed -> airy lavender product grid -> left statement plus pinned accordion -> centred giant statement -> dense dark bento -> backers and partners -> join CTA (from probe headings). Scale alternates between one huge object and a grid of small ones.

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis (html classes 'lenis lenis-smooth'). SmoothScrollLenis component defaults: duration 0.6, wheelMultiplier 1, touchMultiplier 2, smoothTouch false; driven from gsap.ticker with lagSmoothing(0) so ScrollTrigger and Lenis share one clock.
motion.preloader: desktop_00: #5542FF Z mark centred on black. 2024 Branding element (frames/zentry/3, 4.1s clip): black triangles cut into a #5542FF rectangle (f00), collapse into the two-shard Z on black (f02), then a tilted rounded quad (the same clip-mask shape) opens from the centre of the violet field onto the hero art (f04) before the full hero lands (f06).
motion.intro_sequence: Hero (bundle Hero chunk): the top block's children fade in from y 50 over 0.8s power3.out with stagger 0.1 at 0.45s (+0.65s when entering from another page), and BigTitle plays alongside: words are set to opacity 1 one by one with stagger 0.1s (a snap, not a fade) while the h1 rotates from rotateX 40 (-20 on mobile) / rotateY -20 / rotateZ -10 / z -100 to 0 over 1s power4.out. transform-origin is 'center 100% -150px' under perspective(1000px), so the word swings up from a hinge behind its baseline. Slide exit: rotateX -20 / rotateY 60 / z 100 over 1s power4.out, with the words blanked from +0.1s at stagger 0.1. Each slide change plays a random whoosh SFX, with a 1.2s lock between slides. The hero Spline (A1) starts on the Preload / PreloadRiveReady page event; the Intro Spline (B1) starts 300ms after it reports loaded.
scroll_techniques: pin (Intro: ScrollTrigger start 'top top', end 'bottom bottom')
scrub (the frame unfolds while scroll progress runs 0.2-0.85)
motion.text_animation: Title component: the container goes from rotateY -50deg / rotateX -20deg (pivot z -150px, perspective 1000px) to 0 in 1.5s power3.out; the words inside go opacity 0->1 in 0.01s each with stagger 0.07s. Hide: rotateY +50deg in 0.5s power2.in, words blanked from the end, 0.055s each. usePerspectiveFadeEntry (transform-origin center top, perspective 1000px, trigger 'top 95%'): y 120 / rotateX -40 / alpha 0 -> 0 in 1.3s power4.out; reverse y 100 / rotateX -40 in 0.5s power2.in. Buttons: the label rolls (see hover_micro). There are no per-character effects; the 3D hinge carries the motion (frames/zentry/2 f04 catches 'THE STORY' mid-hinge).
motion.image_animation: useCssClipMask: a unit quad [.5,-.5],[.5,.5],[-.5,.5],[-.5,-.5] is scaled to the element size, rotated by an Euler vector, projected with t = fl/(fl + z) (fl 800 default, 3000 on product-menu cards), its corners rounded with Q curves (the radius passed to the path is borderRadius/2, default 5 -> 2.5px), and written to a reactive path used as clip-path: path() plus an SVG <path> stroke (#000 2px default; rgba(255,255,255,.3) 1px on product-menu cards). Intro unfold: frame size lerps from 0.66*min(vw,vh)*(0.7, 1.0) on desktop (1.0*min*(0.7, 1.2) on mobile) to max(vw,vh)+2 as scroll progress runs 0.2->0.85 (0.3->0.85 on mobile). The entry tween takes rotation from (x 1, y -0.2) to (x -0.4, y -0.4, z -0.1) over 1.2s power4.out at +0.2s, and z from -100 to 0 over 1.6s power4.out; scroll adds (0.4t, -0.4t) rad; the summed position and rotation are multiplied by a factor that reaches 0 at t = 0.75, so the frame is flat before it goes full-bleed. The content scales 1.2->1 (1.4s power3.out), plus a scroll term of +0.2 that decays to 0. Mouse parallax (desktop): rotation +/-0.06*PI damped with lambda 6, position width*0.02 with lambda 4. Trailer open (PlayerWrapper): z 500->0 over 1s power4.out, content scale 1.1->1 over 1s power3.out, frame scale 0->1.01 over 0.9s power3.out, rotation x -0.8 / y -0.4 -> 0 over 1.2s power4.out.
motion.page_transitions: inferred: a Nuxt PageTransiton component exists in the bundle; not observed in the frames.
hover_micro: Pill buttons are clip-mask quads too (BtnMain): the pill is an SVG path from useCssClipMask. On pointerenter it rotates (x -0.1, y -0.8, z -0.06 rad) over 0.4s expo.out and pushes back (z -100, x +2% of width) over 0.8s expo.out, while its corner radius lerps from ~h/1.8 to 4, so the capsule squares off and swings into perspective. Desktop only.

Label roll (verified in BtnMain): each label is rendered twice ('WHITEPAPER\nWHITEPAPER' in the probe). On hover the main label and icon fade out in 0.15s (stagger 0.04) and the rollover copy slides up from y 100% to 0 over 0.8s expo.out (stagger 0.04); on leave the main copy drops back in from -100%. A Howler ui.mp3 rollover sprite plays; a click plays 'UI_generic_click'.
Bento stat numerals: at rest rolloverPr = 1 keeps the corner-pinned lean; hovering the card tweens rolloverPr to 0 over 1s expo.out and the numeral straightens (Bento + BentoCard chunks).
Product card tilt (ProductGrid): the pointer maps to rotateX/rotateY clamped to +/-3deg (rotMax 3) under perspective(500px).
WhoWeAre dot: pointerenter expands a small inline dot into an image card (showPr 0->1 over 1.2s power4.out; idle pulse 1 + sin(t*0.003)*0.15).

2024 hero: the preview square of the next clip holds screen centre. The Hero code feeds the normalised window pointer to each slide's media (setPointer); inferred: this drives a tilt or parallax, not position-following. Clicking grows the preview to full-bleed (frames/zentry/2 f00 caught mid-expansion).
motion.cursor: Native cursor (cursor_none 0). Pointer response is expressed through tilt: buttons, product cards, the intro frame and the product-menu ring all rotate toward the pointer.
motion.duration_range_ms: 10-2000 (GSAP word snaps 10ms, fades 150ms, typical 500-1200ms, the longest GSAP move 1.6s; CSS durations from 40ms to 2s with 0.5s most common)
motion.stagger_ms: 70 (Title words), 100 (BigTitle words, product-menu titles), 55 (Title hide, from end), 40 (button label roll), 80 (product-menu blurb)
motion.choreography_notes: The container moves in 3D first; words snap on inside it, so the eye tracks one rigid slab rather than a cascade. Entrances are slow and decelerating (1-1.6s, power3/4.out); exits are fast and accelerating (0.5s, power2.in). Image frames always lead the text: frame z/scale starts at t=0 and the text fades in at +0.4s (Intro timeline).

steal_this.technique: 3D-projected rounded-quad clip mask (DOM images that behave like cards in space)
steal_this.why_it_works: You get perspective, tilt and fly-in on real /
steal_this.how_to_build: Per element keep {position:Vector3, rotation:Euler, scale:[w,h], borderRadius}. Each rAF: corners = [[.5,-.5,0],[.5,.5,0],[-.5,.5,0],[-.5,-.5,0]].map(c => c.multiply(scale).applyEuler(rotation)); project each: t = fl/(fl + c.z + pos.z) with fl=800 (3000 for a flatter look); p = pos.xy + c.xy*t. Build the path: for each corner, step back r along both edges (the site passes borderRadius/2, clamped so it never exceeds half an edge), 'L' to the first point, then 'Q corner, secondPoint'; close with Z. Apply el.style.clipPath = `path('${d}')` and set the same d on an absolutely positioned <svg><path stroke='#000' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/></svg> for the hairline. Drive rotation/position with GSAP (e.g. rotation (1,-0.2) -> (-0.4,-0.4,-0.1) over 1.2s power4.out, z -100->0 over 1.6s power4.out) plus a damped mouse term (+/-0.06*PI, lambda 6). Recompute only while animating or hovered (useRafBool).

steal_this.technique: Hinged headline entrance (rigid 3D swing + word snap)
steal_this.why_it_works: The block moves as one heavy object that lands; words snapping on at 70-100ms reads like type being stamped, not the generic per-letter fade.
steal_this.how_to_build: Wrapper: perspective:1000px; inner: transform-origin: center 100% -150px, will-change: transform. Split into words (SplitText type:'words') and set them to opacity 0 only in the split's onReady, right before the play. Entrance (BigTitle): tl.set(words,{opacity:1, stagger:0.1}, 0).fromTo(inner,{rotateX:40 (use -20 on mobile), rotateY:-20, rotateZ:-10, z:-100},{rotateX:0, rotateY:0, rotateZ:0, z:0, duration:1, ease:'power4.out'},0). Exit (BigTitle): to(inner,{rotateX:-20, rotateY:60, z:100, duration:1, ease:'power4.out'}) with words set back to opacity 0 from +0.1s at stagger 0.1. For section titles use the Title variant: rotateY -50 / rotateX -20 (pivot z -150px) -> 0 over 1.5s power3.out, words at 0.07s; hide = rotateY +50 over 0.5s power2.in, words blanked from the end at 0.055s.

steal_this.technique: Scroll-scrubbed frame unfold: tilted portrait card -> full-bleed scene
steal_this.why_it_works: The section change happens inside an image the user already sees, so the scroll feels like walking into the picture instead of paging.
steal_this.how_to_build: Pin a 200-300vh section (ScrollTrigger start 'top top', end 'bottom bottom', onUpdate gives p). t = clamp(map(p, 0.2, 0.85, 0, 1)) (0.3 on mobile). Frame size = lerp(0.66*min(vw,vh)*[0.7, 1.0], [max(vw,vh)+2, max(vw,vh)+2], t) (use 1.0*min*[0.7,1.2] on mobile). Rotation = entryRotation + (0.4t, -0.4t) + mouseRotation, and position = offsetY + entryZ + mouseOffset; multiply both by clamp(map(1-t, 1, 0.25, 1, 0)) so the tilt is gone by t = 0.75 and the last stretch is a flat zoom to full-bleed. Content scale = entryScale(1.2->1) + 0.2*(1-t). Feed these into the clip-mask routine above. A ThemeTrigger at 'top bottom-=1px' switches the page theme (#000 -> #DFDFF2), so the unfolding image carries the section seam.

steal_this.technique: Per-glyph stylistic-set accent in display headlines
steal_this.why_it_works: One notched letter per word carries the logo DNA into every headline without a custom lettering job per heading.
steal_this.how_to_build: Ship the display font with an ss01 alternate for the accent glyphs (the site cuts a wedge into A, M, U, W and C). In the CMS rich text allow <b> as a 'glyph accent' mark; CSS: h1 b { font-weight: inherit; font-feature-settings: 'ss01' on; } (Zentry resets b to 400 because it loads a single face). Set html { font-synthesis: none } as the site does, because the face loads as one 500 file while CSS asks for 900. Display at 20rem on a .625vw root (12.5vw), line-height 0.82, letter-spacing -0.01em, uppercase. Use one accent per word at most.

steal_this.technique: Scroll-to-select product menu with a rotating 3D card stack
steal_this.why_it_works: A 4-item menu becomes a showcase: giant names give scannable hierarchy, and the tilted card stack previews each product without leaving the page.
steal_this.how_to_build: Full-screen overlay on radial-gradient(circle at 65%, #100731 20%, #080315 60%) with black fades top and bottom. Make it its own scroller (data-lenis-prevent + a nested Lenis instance, duration 0.6) over a tall inner track with a sticky stage. progress = scrollTop / (innerH - vh); index = min(floor(progress*n), n-1); translate the name list by -progress*listHeight so the active name stays on one band. Names are 12rem display caps, #5542FF, turning #fff on focus or hover. Right: 5 clip-mask cards (fl 3000, 1px rgba(255,255,255,.3) stroke) placed around a ring at 2*PI/5 intervals. Damp ring.rotation.y (damping 8) toward 2*PI*index/5, add a pointer tilt of +/-0.1*PI (damping 6), and render only cards within index+/-3. Open timeline: overlay opacity 0->1 in 0.3s sine.out; list y 40vh->0 in 0.8s expo.out; card group z -1200->0 and rz 0.1*PI->-0.04*PI in 1s power3.out; ring y -0.7*PI->0 in 1.2s power4.out; names play the Title hinge at 0.1s stagger; the blurb enters y 20->0 over 0.6s power3.out, stagger 0.08. Play a short tick per index change; Escape closes it; clicking a name scrolls to its slot.

steal_this.technique: Corner-pinned stat numerals that straighten on hover
steal_this.why_it_works: A plain metric card gets a physical, poster-like lean without images or WebGL, and the hover rewards the pointer by 'squaring up' the number, so the bento stops reading as a template.
steal_this.how_to_build: Measure the numeral element (w,h). Keep four points tl(0,0), tr(w,0), bl(0, lerp(k, h, 1.5h)), br(w, lerp(k, h, 0.5h)) with k = rolloverPr (1 at rest). Solve the 8x8 homography from the unit rect to those points and write it as transform: matrix3d(...) (perspective-transform.js style; skip frames where the quad degenerates). Tween k to 0 on pointerenter and back to 1 on leave over 1s expo.out. Vary the pin per card (1.3/0.6 vs 1.5/0.5) so neighbours lean differently.

steal_this.technique: 3D clip-mask pill buttons that square off on hover
steal_this.why_it_works: The button shares the site's physical-card language: on hover the capsule swings into perspective and its corners sharpen while the label rolls, so it changes state without the default lift-and-glow.
steal_this.how_to_build: Draw the button background as an SVG path from the clip-mask routine (fl 800). State: rotation, position, lerpBorder. pointerenter: rotation -> (x -0.1, y -0.8, z -0.06) over 0.4s expo.out, position -> (x +2% of width, z -100) over 0.8s expo.out, lerpBorder 0->1 over 0.8s expo.out with radius = lerp(lerpBorder, h/1.8, 4). Label: two stacked copies in overflow-clipped spans; the main copy fades out in 0.15s while the rollover copy rises from y 100% to 0 over 0.8s expo.out (stagger 0.04 across text and icon). Reverse on leave. Skip the tilt on touch.

slop_risks: Purple / blue-to-purple palette: #5542FF, the #100731 -> #080315 radial menu field, the #3427AC glow on the 24B+ card and a violet iridescent hero object together are the default crypto-AI purple. The logomark earns it here; a copy without a brand reason reads as slop, and the #3427AC corner glow on the 24B+ card is the 'background glow' tell in miniature.

Monospace as the house voice + one label treatment everywhere: the 2026 relaunch sets all body copy, nav, buttons and eyebrows in Roboto Mono (154 of 226 text nodes), with 9px uppercase mono labels on every section. The 2024 site used a sans for body copy; copy that instead.

Content hidden until a reveal fires: Title / BigTitle words start at opacity 0 and depend on JS; desktop_04 shows the Radiant/Zigma card titles and blurbs still near-invisible with empty media, and desktop_05's right half is an empty field where the vault art should be. Keep headings visible in CSS and only arm the hide when the timeline is about to play.
Numbered steps beside a vertical line: the 01/02/03 accordion with a vertical rule (desktop_05) is exactly the 'numbered steps on a rail' preset.
Saturated accent pop: poster-bright lime #EDFF66 pill + #5542FF card fills. They work as whole-section fields; sprinkled as dots/labels they would be the saturated-accent tell.

Metrics bento: '24B+ / 970GB+ / 100M+ / 500K+' number cards are a startup-template move. What rescues it is the corner-pinned lean of the numerals that straightens on hover and, in 2024, a character layered over the numerals; a flat copy is slop.
Hairline light border on boxes: the black bento cards (24B+, 500K+, WORLD-CLASS BACKERS) each wear a faint 1px grey outline on black (desktop_07). Separate them with tone or spacing instead.

Small label over big heading, repeated: 'WHO WE ARE' over the giant statement (desktop_06), 'OUR UNIVERSE IN A NUTSHELL' over 'ZENTRY AT A GLANCE' (frames/zentry/2 f07), 'THE MULTIVERSAL IP' over 'THE STORY' (f04). The 3D hinge makes each one move well, but the skeleton is the kicker-plus-heading preset used on every section.

Hard colour seam: in the 2026 build the intro frame's flat bottom edge cuts straight across the lavender section (desktop_03). The unfold hides it while moving, but a static copy keeps the dark-to-lavender wall.
